text.en: Dog guardians enthusiastically commend Olivia and Clodagh for their expertise, generosity, and genuine passion for canine welfare. Reviewers frequently note that the trainers demonstrate deep insight into working breeds, gun dogs, and rescue temperaments. Clients appreciate the supportive feedback and personalized guidance offered between sessions.

Pet owners report noticeable behavioral improvements, from resolving severe car anxiety to mastering structured obedience in group courses. Clients completing puppy foundation and gun dog classes highlight clear course structures that help dogs thrive. Reviewers express lasting satisfaction with the practical techniques learned during training.

title.en: Support for rescues and working breeds

text.en: Reviewers praise the trainers' tailored approaches for diverse breeds including Vizslas, German Shorthaired Pointers, cocker spaniels, and rescue dogs. Owners highlight that training sessions focus on canine confidence and well-being, keeping dogs happy and engaged. Pet guardians feel supported in providing their companions with fulfilling lives.

q.en: Does Canine Connect offer one-to-one training consultations?

a.en: Yes, clients frequently book individual sessions as well as structured group training classes.

q.en: Can owners access remote training consultations?

a.en: Yes, reviewers living outside Cork commend the online consultations for effectively resolving behavioral issues such as car travel anxiety.

q.en: What types of group classes are available?

a.en: Clients report completing bronze puppy classes, gun dog obedience courses, and progressing through advanced levels.

q.en: Does the training suit rescue dogs with behavioral challenges?

a.en: Yes, guardians of rescue dogs report significant behavioral progress and confidence-building through tailored training methods.
